title: Add claudio as an example of using Anthropic speech-to-text
author: ayushkumar1808
body_preview: Repository: https://github.com/ayushkumar1808/claudio  claudio is a macOS menu bar app demonstrating use of Anthropic's speech-to-text WebSocket API (Deepgram Nova 3 backend). It shows how to authenticate with Claude's OAuth token from the macOS Keychain and stream Float32 audio to the API. MIT license.  Might be useful as a real-world example in the cookbook for audio/voice use cases.
